title: Vintage French Cast Iron Kitchen Set – Rooster Paper Towel Holder & Sunflower Mug Tree
description:
Beautiful vintage-style cast iron kitchen accessories with a charming French country look.
The set includes:
• Rooster paper towel holder – hand-painted cast iron with detailed rooster design, perfect for a farmhouse or rustic kitchen.
• Sunflower mug tree – sturdy cast iron stand decorated with sunflowers, ideal for holding mugs or small cups.
Both pieces are heavy, durable cast iron and feature lovely hand-painted details in warm countryside colors. They make a great decorative and practical addition to a farmhouse, rustic, or French country kitchen.
Condition: Good vintage condition with minor signs of use consistent with age.
Perfect for collectors, farmhouse décor lovers, or as a unique kitchen gift.
